answer: Non-transferable, decaying reputation: rights are earned per task domain and fade when unused, so masks cannot be bought, sold, or batched. Each new identity then enters a witnessed ceremony where a public random seed, the digital yarrow, assigns its audit cohort, so an owner cannot steer fakes into a lenient jury. A farm must cultivate every clone separately, like plants in a garden, paying full onboarding each time with no shortcut; honest work blooms once and persists. The extras never reach the payout ledge.
